scripts.compile: node build-scripts/dist-tools.js clean && tsc --project tsconfig.main.json && node build-scripts/dist-tools.js copy
scripts.prebuild: npm run compile && npm run licenses
scripts.start: npm run clean && npm run compile && electron . --ozone-platform=x11
scripts.dev: npm run compile && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron . --dev --ozone-platform=x11
scripts.build:win:all: npm run build:win && npm run build:win:x64 && npm run build:win:arm64
scripts.build:mac:universal: npm run prebuild && dotenv -e .env -- electron-builder -c electron-builder.base.yml --mac --universal
scripts.build:linux: npm run prebuild && electron-builder -c electron-builder.base.yml --linux AppImage deb rpm --x64 --arm64
scripts.build:linux:x64: node build-scripts/build-with-restore.js --prepare build-scripts/prepare-linux-x64.js -- npx electron-builder -c electron-builder.base.yml --linux AppImage deb rpm --x64
scripts.build:linux:arm64: node build-scripts/build-with-restore.js --prepare build-scripts/prepare-linux-arm64.js -- npx electron-builder -c electron-builder.base.yml --linux AppImage deb rpm --arm64
scripts.build:linux:all: npm run prebuild && npm run build:linux:x64 && npm run build:linux:arm64
scripts.build:linux:native: npm run prebuild && npm run build:linux:native:x64 && npm run build:linux:native:arm64
scripts.build:linux:native:x64: node build-scripts/build-with-restore.js --prepare build-scripts/prepare-linux-x64.js --env USE_SYSTEM_FPM=true -- npx electron-builder -c electron-builder.base.yml --linux AppImage deb rpm --x64
scripts.build:linux:native:arm64: node build-scripts/build-with-restore.js --prepare build-scripts/prepare-linux-arm64.js --env USE_SYSTEM_FPM=true -- npx electron-builder -c electron-builder.base.yml --linux AppImage deb rpm --arm64
scripts.build:linux:native:all: npm run prebuild && npm run build:linux:native:x64 && npm run build:linux:native:arm64
scripts.build:github: npm run prebuild && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env CHANNEL=github electron-builder -c electron-builder.github.yml --win --arm64 --x64
scripts.build:github:win: npm run prebuild && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env CHANNEL=github electron-builder -c electron-builder.github.yml --win --arm64 --x64
scripts.build:github:mac: npm run prebuild && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env CHANNEL=github electron-builder -c electron-builder.github.yml --mac --universal
scripts.build:msstore:x64: node build-scripts/build-with-restore.js --prepare build-scripts/prepare-x64.js --env CHANNEL=msstore -- npx electron-builder --win --x64 -c electron-builder.msstore.yml
scripts.build:msstore:arm64: node build-scripts/build-with-restore.js --prepare build-scripts/prepare-arm64.js --env CHANNEL=msstore -- npx electron-builder --win --arm64 -c electron-builder.msstore.yml
scripts.build:msstore: npm run prebuild && npm run build:msstore:x64 && npm run build:msstore:arm64
scripts.release:win: npm run prebuild && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env CHANNEL=github electron-builder -c electron-builder.github.yml --win --arm64 --x64 --publish always && npm run sign:gpg
scripts.release:win:x64: npm run prebuild && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env CHANNEL=github electron-builder -c electron-builder.github.yml --win --x64 --publish always && npm run sign:gpg
scripts.release:win:arm64: npm run prebuild && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env CHANNEL=github electron-builder -c electron-builder.github.yml --win --arm64 --publish always && npm run sign:gpg
scripts.release:mac: npm run prebuild && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env CHANNEL=github electron-builder -c electron-builder.github.yml --mac --universal --publish always && npm run sign:gpg
scripts.release:linux:chain: npm run prebuild && npm run release:linux:x64 && npm run release:linux:arm64
scripts.release:linux:chain:f: npm run prebuild && npm run release:linux:native:x64 && npm run release:linux:native:arm64
scripts.release:linux: npm run prebuild && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env CHANNEL=github electron-builder -c electron-builder.github.yml --linux AppImage deb rpm --x64 --arm64 --publish always && npm run sign:gpg
scripts.release:linux:x64: dotenv -e .env -- node build-scripts/build-with-restore.js --prepare build-scripts/prepare-linux-x64.js --env CHANNEL=github -- npx electron-builder -c electron-builder.github.yml --linux AppImage deb rpm --x64 --publish always && npm run sign:gpg:x64
scripts.release:linux:arm64: dotenv -e .env -- node build-scripts/build-with-restore.js --prepare build-scripts/prepare-linux-arm64.js --env CHANNEL=github -- npx electron-builder -c electron-builder.github.yml --linux AppImage deb rpm --arm64 --publish always && npm run sign:gpg:arm64
scripts.release:linux:native:x64: dotenv -e .env -- node build-scripts/build-with-restore.js --prepare build-scripts/prepare-linux-x64.js --env USE_SYSTEM_FPM=true --env CHANNEL=github -- npx electron-builder -c electron-builder.github.yml --linux AppImage deb rpm --x64 --publish always && npm run sign:gpg:x64
scripts.release:linux:native:arm64: dotenv -e .env -- node build-scripts/build-with-restore.js --prepare build-scripts/prepare-linux-arm64.js --env USE_SYSTEM_FPM=true --env CHANNEL=github -- npx electron-builder -c electron-builder.github.yml --linux AppImage deb rpm --arm64 --publish always && npm run sign:gpg:arm64
scripts.release:all: npm run prebuild && npm run release:mac && npm run release:win && npm run release:linux
